reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators define a temporal causal structure where OOF estimation enforces statistical independence between training and test phases. The weekly seal ensures that model parameters do not mutate mid-cycle, preserving the integrity of the baseline forecast. The three-zone firewall isolates live data inputs to prevent contamination of the predictive pipeline. These primitives collectively enforce a dual duality: one between temporal causality and statistical validity, and another between epistemic purity and operational robustness. Failure modes include lookahead leakage, unauthorized parameter mutation, and cross-zone data injection, all of which compromise either the temporal consistency or the epistemic closure of the system.
